goals: Maintain the private Foundation resource pack for Minecraft Java 26.2 without modifying its immutable source archive.
scope: Foundation v6 consolidates exact Foundation v5 with Matcha Overlays v37, using Matcha bytes on every shared asset path while retaining Foundation branding and all non-colliding content.

exclusions: originals/resourcepacks/Foundation v4.zip and originals/resourcepacks/Matcha-Overlays-v37.zip are immutable and are neither changed nor redistributed.
Block Geometry Extensions, BGE x Bushy Leaves, Mynx Trees Java code, Enderscape Integration Java code, Enderscape Overlays, and unrelated projects are outside this resource-pack consolidation.
No Minecraft test profile is inspected or changed.

dependencies.reason: Supplies the complete Foundation v5 baseline, including its bushy-leaf item-preview fixes.
Supplies the higher-precedence overlay bytes for every collision and all Matcha-only resources.
Defines the assets/<namespace>/items/<id>.json item-model selector convention used by the correction.

state.milestone: Foundation v6 consolidates Foundation v5 and Matcha Overlays v37 with Matcha winning all shared asset paths; static archive validation passed and runtime testing remains outstanding.

current.summary: Consolidates Foundation v5 and Matcha Overlays v37 with Matcha winning all shared assets in one Foundation-branded pack.
